description: Compare nutrients side-by-side for 2–5 foods. Returns a structured table — one row per nutrient, one column per food — formatted as markdown. Best for "spinach vs kale iron" or "which has more protein?" questions. Omit nutrients[] to use the 12 most common defaults (energy, protein, fat, saturated fat, carbs, fiber, sugars, sodium, potassium, calcium, iron, vitamin C); a food that lacks the default energy (1008) or total sugars (2000) value has that cell filled from its equivalent nutrient — energy from 2048, then 2047; sugars from 1063 — and each fill is listed in substitutions. Provide nutrients[] with specific FDC IDs to compare different nutrients; an explicit list is compared as given, without fills. All values are scaled to the same basis, quantity in unit: default 100 g, so unit="oz" alone compares per 100 oz and quantity alone is grams. A Branded food FDC reports per 100 ml (basisUnit "ml") or per 100 of a label unit that fixes neither (basisUnit absent) is compared on that basis without conversion, and a notice names it. If one or more FDC IDs are not found, the comparison proceeds with the valid foods — only throws too_few_foods when fewer than 2 IDs return data.

fdcIds.description: FDC IDs to compare — 2 to 5 foods. Use usda_search_foods to discover IDs.

nutrients.description: Nutrient IDs to include in the comparison. Defaults to the 12 most common: energy (1008), protein (1003), total fat (1004), saturated fat (1258), carbohydrate (1005), fiber (1079), total sugars (2000), sodium (1093), potassium (1092), calcium (1087), iron (1089), vitamin C (1162). Under the defaults, a food missing energy or total sugars has that cell filled from its equivalent nutrient (listed in substitutions); IDs given here are compared as given. Use usda_list_nutrients to look up other IDs.

quantity.description: Amount of food, in unit, that every value is scaled to. Must be positive. Default 100.

unit.description: Unit for quantity. Default "g". Does not support "serving" (each food's portion weight differs, so a serving basis would not compare equal amounts).

name: usda_compare_foods

basis.description: The common scaling basis applied to all nutrient values.

gramWeight.description: Gram weight resolved from quantity and unit — every column is per this many grams, except that a food with basisUnit "ml" is per this many millilitres and one with no basisUnit per this many label units, compared without conversion.

quantity.description: Quantity applied, in unit — the requested value or the default 100.

unit.description: Unit applied (g, oz, lb, or kg) — the requested value or the default "g".

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `too_few_foods`: Fewer than 2 of the provided FDC IDs returned data, making comparison impossible. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

foods.description: The compared foods, in the same order as the values arrays below.

basisUnit.description: What the per-100 nutrient values are measured in: "g" for every non-Branded food and for Branded labels in g/GRM/GM, "ml" for Branded labels in ml/MLT. Absent when the label unit (e.g. IU, MG) fixes neither, so the basis is unverified.

dataType.description: FDC data source: SR Legacy, Foundation, Survey (FNDDS), or Branded.

servingSizeUnit.description: Label serving unit as FDC reports it (e.g. "GRM", "MLT", "IU"); it sets basisUnit. Branded items only.

missingData.description: Foods or food+nutrient pairs where data was unavailable. A cell filled from an equivalent nutrient is listed in substitutions, not here. Absent when all data was present.

items.description: A food or food+nutrient pair where data was unavailable.

fdcId.description: FDC ID that had missing data.

nutrientId.description: Nutrient ID that was missing, or null when the entire food was not found.

notice.description: Basis caveat naming each compared food not reported per 100 g: an ml food compared per basis.gramWeight millilitres, or a food whose per-100 basis is unverified, both without conversion.

nutrients.description: Nutrient rows — one entry per requested nutrient, with per-food values in the values[] array.

items.description: One nutrient row with per-food values.

values.description: One value per food in the same order as foods[]. null when data is unavailable for that food.

substitutions.description: Default-row cells filled from an equivalent nutrient because the food does not report the row ID, in nutrients[] then foods[] order. Absent when nothing was filled.

items.description: One default-row cell filled from an equivalent nutrient.

fdcId.description: FDC ID of the food whose cell was filled.

requested.description: Nutrient ID of the row: 1008 (energy) or 2000 (total sugars).

used.description: Nutrient ID the value was taken from: 2048 or 2047 for energy, 1063 for sugars.

title: Compare USDA Foods
